writePathAudit.before: No new semantic rule should be introduced.

writePathAudit.sources: Existing checked body or original source authority.

writePathAudit.path: Raw engine writes and generated summaries
writePathAudit.before: Engine can write before control-plane settlement.
writePathAudit.after: Review begins once a diff is available; maintenance cannot gate it. Summaries are excluded from active memory recall and rebuilt from corrected bodies.
writePathAudit.sources: Engine diff plus preserved archive. This does not make upstream extraction and control-plane review one atomic transaction.

sourceStructure.notAvailable: The capture boundary already removes tool, attachment and non-text parts. No lost attachment/excerpt annotations are fabricated; undelimited supplied material is interpreted semantically from the whole message.
sourceStructure.meaningJudgedBy: Two separate model requests with no shared verdict; json_object responses validated by code, including offered indices, source binding and exact quotations. No keyword or regex meaning classifier.
sourceStructure.disagreement: Recoverable pending item outside active memory, visible on the memory page; existing Undo provides explicit adoption/recovery.
sourceStructure.limits: One distinct candidate per request; exact equivalent text/source bindings share a result for all original indices, never sampling. No daily cap. Missing sources, oversized inputs, unavailable model and invalid/disagreeing responses leave affected lines pending. Receipts and policy/model/source-bound durable cache make retries auditable.
